name: Dalia Basquiat
source:
One of the nuns at Saint Angraecum Academy. She is a mild and tolerant teacher, and is more like a laidback older sister than a mother.
Because she is a strict follower of Catholicism, she has a tendency to apply her religion to things that have nothing to do with it.
She is in charge of the ballet lessons for the first year students and is well trusted by them.
Thinking that she should turn her attention toward something other than religion, she has recently been raising her namesake flower, the dahlia, in the greenhouse and creating new varieties by her own hand.
Her interests are ballet and gardening.
